plugin.name: QuickTransferForCLOK
plugin.author: ironcross32
plugin.purpose: allows for easy and fast transfers of materials from any container to anywhere else
plugin.description: this plugin allows one to quickly configure two containers, or the ground, for easy transfers. 1. type fromcont <container> 2. type tocont <container> 3. use qt like this: qt animal fat; qt bandage; qt poultice The items will be transferred from the container you set using fromcont, and to the one you set using tocont. 4. Optionally use swapconts to slip the from and to, allowing transfers in the reverse direction i.e. from a backpack to the ground, and then from the ground into the backpack once more.

alias.send: if ("%1" == "from") then SetVariable ("fromcont", "%2") Note("You set the from container to " .. GetVariable("fromcont") .. ".") elseif ("%1" == "to") then SetVariable("tocont", "%2") Note("You set the to container to " .. GetVariable("tocont") .. ".") end --if

a = GetVariable("fromcont") b = GetVariable("tocont") SetVariable("tocont", a) SetVariable("fromcont", b) Note("You've flipped them around so you will now be transferring from " .. GetVariable("fromcont") .. " and transferring to " .. GetVariable("tocont") .. ".")
